title: Davide Gentile
text:
I research whether human oversight of AI actually functions in practice — not whether a human is nominally "in the loop," but whether their supervision measurably changes outcomes. My work runs controlled experiments on how operators supervise machine-learning systems, and finds that the explanations meant to support oversight can be present and still degrade an operator's judgment.
